title: Kur'an-ı Kerim ve Türkçe Anlamı (Diyanet İşleri, 1961; Hüseyin Atay - Yaşar Kutluay)
author: Hüseyin Atay & Yaşar Kutluay (Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı)
translator: Hüseyin Atay & Yaşar Kutluay (Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı)
edition: tanzil tr.diyanet (last update 2011-12-27); identified by kuranmeali.com as the old 1961 Diyanet meal (Atay-Kutluay)
licence: tanzil.net translation terms: non-commercial use, verbatim, cite tanzil.net; rights remain with translator/publisher; local research copy only.
notes: Identity: kuranmeali.com about-page (id 11): e-text of the DİB meal, first edition 1961, prepared by Dr. Hüseyin Atay and Dr. Yaşar Kutluay under Hasan Hüsnü Erdem and Yusuf Ziyaeddin Ersal, revised by a committee chaired by Mahir İz; used by DİB until c. 1990. tanzil tr.diyanet = fawaz tur-diyanetisleri = kuranmeali "Diyanet İşleri Meali (Eski)" = mealler.org "Diyanet İşleri (eski)". mealler.org "Bekir Sadak" is also this text (~88% identical, ASCII-ised variants), i.e. a mislabelled copy. tanzil represents a merged verse group by repeating the group text on each ayah; consecutive identical ayat are stored once as a..a_end (except Arabic near-twins such as 94:5-6, 102:3-4). 571 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end.
